Definition: to cheat; by analogy, to maltreat
BiblicalUsage: 1) to deceive, misuse; 1a) (Pilpel); 1a1) to be a mocker, mock; 1a2) mocker (subst); 1b) (Hithpalpel); 1b1) to ridicule; 1b2) mocking (participle)
